name: openexpense.org
description: Encrypted local expense ledger. Current funds, projected income, and a calendar wallet that never leaves the browser.

scripts.build: node scripts/write-sitemap.mjs && npx esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --splitting --alias:onnxruntime-web=onnxruntime-web/wasm --outdir=. --entry-names=app --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] && npx esbuild src/engine/index.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=engine.js
scripts.test: node --test scripts/qc-envelope.mjs scripts/qc-ledger-file.mjs scripts/qc-expense-income.mjs scripts/qc-undo-delete.mjs scripts/qc-day-entries.mjs scripts/qc-engine.mjs
